name: CF 808
description: TS808-style overdrive ported from Comet Flower's mobile drive core: 720 Hz split, diode clipping stage with ADAA, 2x oversampling, 723 Hz post-clip pole, pole-zero tone.

params.name: Drive
params.explanation: Gain of the clipping stage (the TS808 drive pot, audio taper).

params.name: Tone
params.explanation: Sweeps the tone network's zero from 723 Hz to 33 kHz.

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Output level. 80 is the original's default level.
